technical-summary: Hardened managed experiment-bundle lifecycle validation. Intent documents now reject terminal fields/evidence; completed, failed, and interrupted bundles require complete canonical process evidence matching intended artifacts, strict lifecycle fields, and validated artifact metadata and hashes. Existing atomic bundle writes and top-level bundle hashing remain enforced.
user-summary-candidate: Added fail-closed lifecycle and evidence validation for interrupted/failed experiment bundles, including atomic manifest/hash consistency checks.
